verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's documented parameters (JS rendering, premium_proxy, extract_rules, js_scenario and others) are set per individual API request. The CLI `crawl` command offers same-domain, sitemap, or Scrapy-spider crawls, but nothing in the evidence shows a batch job that maps different crawl configurations to different URL patterns. Varying settings across a batch would mean issuing separate requests or writing your own Scrapy logic, which is not a documented product capability.
